content:
- Pushed commit 99e95dd to origin/master successfully.
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh; it refreshed current task summaries, sent the status email, and printed the same harmless missing .ralph/current_task.txt removal message.
- If resuming later: the cli/connect smell-10 cleanup is complete and pushed; the worktree now contains fresh post-switch .ralph updates plus the pre-existing unrelated user edits in src/pginfo/startup.rs and tests/ha/support/timeouts/mod.rs.

- Read prior progress and loaded the improve-code-boundaries skill.
- Confirmed unrelated pre-existing worktree changes in src/pginfo/startup.rs and tests/ha/support/timeouts/mod.rs, plus fresh .ralph task-switch updates.
- Next: inspect found_smells, pick the required smell, and make one boundary cleanup without disturbing unrelated edits.

- Inspected found smell files and chose the pginfo state/query smell-6 candidate because it reuses the existing poll snapshot type and avoids touching unrelated user edits.
- Verified the current boundary leak: pginfo/query::PgPollData still carries raw primary_conninfo text and pginfo/state::to_member_status parses it later.
- Next: move that parse into query.rs, make the shared snapshot typed, then collapse to_member_status into an infallible mapper before lint/test.

- Implemented the pginfo smell-6 boundary cleanup: PgPollData now carries typed primary_conninfo in query.rs, state.rs no longer reparses it, and to_member_status became infallible.
- Ran cargo fmt --all to satisfy formatting after the worker match arm wrapped.
- Next: run make lint and make test, then remove the processed smell notes, commit, push, and switch tasks.

- First lint run failed on an inferred row.try_get type; patched query.rs to decode primary_conninfo as Option<String> before parsing.
- Second lint run then flagged private-interface mismatches because PgPollData was narrowed to pub(super) while poll_once/to_member_status remained pub(crate).
- Next: tighten those function visibilities to the pginfo boundary, rerun lint, then continue to make test.

- make lint passed after tightening query/state helper visibility to match the narrowed pginfo poll snapshot boundary.
- make test passed: 232 tests passed, 16 skipped, with the pre-existing 5 leaky tests reported by nextest.
- Next: delete the processed pginfo smell note (and the previously completed cli smell note still lingering), review the final diff, commit including .ralph, push, and run task_switch.

- Staged only the intended pginfo boundary cleanup, the processed smell-note deletions, and the requested .ralph files.
- Confirmed the unrelated dirty files src/pginfo/startup.rs and tests/ha/support/timeouts/mod.rs remain unstaged.
- Next: commit this staged set, push it, then run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh.
